total_weight_after_reset.meaning: totalWeight after voters call reset in the next epoch's window
total_weight_after_reset.checkpoint: after voters reset, before emission distribution

gauge_claimable_after_distribution.meaning: claimable value of the gauges after the epoch emission distribution attempt

zero_claimable.meaning: the zero claimable value the impact reports gauges remain at

assumptions: The epoch emission distribution attempt occurs after voters reset totalWeight to zero.
The gauges' claimable is the observable reward-flow accounting location referenced by the intent.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the expected nonzero claimable amount or the exact accounting relation between a minted emission and gauges' claimable, so the desired correspondence cannot be fully quantified beyond the reported claimable==0 outcome.

limitations: Only the selected impact gauges_remain_at_claimable_zero is formalized; stranded GaugeManager balance is not covered by this plan.
The report does not specify whether notifyRewardAmount is called directly or via distributeAll; the checkpoint is the post-distribution state.
